speaker_design.cadence_requirement: Test panel must contain deliberate slow, conversational, and fast-but-intelligible delivery assignments distributed across speakers; assignment is frozen before recording.
speaker_design.identity_minimization: Use pseudonymous speaker ids. Do not require sensitive demographic attributes for benchmark eligibility or publish identifying metadata.
speaker_design.rationale: Twelve held-out test speakers provide speaker-disjoint replication rather than a single-voice benchmark; 24 developer-entity utterances per test speaker yields 288 primary developer utterances while keeping recording burden bounded. Four development and four qualification speakers permit methodology/harness work without touching test speakers. The design is descriptive benchmark evidence, not a population-level inferential claim.

preprocessing.float32_adapter_rule: Decode canonical WAV PCM payload samples as little-endian signed int16 and convert each sample to float32 as sample / 32768.0 with no clipping, gain, denoising, or candidate-specific preprocessing.

moonshine.integration: Pinned Moonshine Transcriber streaming API; feed samples decoded deterministically from canonical WAV in 500 ms chunks and finalize after universal zero pad.

whisper.cpp.integration: Research adapter reproduces pinned examples/stream non-VAD fixed-step decode semantics over samples decoded deterministically from canonical WAV; no microphone capture dependency in evidence harness.

sherpa-onnx.integration: OnlineRecognizer.from_transducer; feed samples decoded deterministically from canonical WAV in 500 ms chunks, decode while ready, feed universal zero pad, call input_finished, then drain ready states.

fairness_notes: CPU-only is frozen for the founding C0 comparison; controlled performance evidence remains separately gated.

Thread count is four where the pinned public API exposes it. Moonshine does not document an STT thread-count option in the pinned options surface, so this asymmetry is explicit and prevents general CPU-efficiency claims from uncontrolled C0 evidence.

The 660 ms zero tail is a universal feed finalization suffix delivered to every candidate after the speech_audio_end marker; it is not part of the human reference transcript and is identical across candidates.
No backend-native prompt, keyterm, hotword, repository vocabulary, external LM, or post-decode entity correction is permitted in C0.
